verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents connecting GitLab to external CI/CD systems such as Jenkins or other CI services as an alternative to native pipelines. The CI/CD material covers GitLab's own pipelines (GitLab CI, the Pulumi integration with GitLab CI, DigiCert signing in GitLab CI/CD pipelines). The REST API and Make webhook evidence are generic automation, not documented external-CI integration, and one community comment says some external CI services do not integrate with GitLab.
